model_forms.prediction_equation: pred(c, t+k) = mean_y[c] + Σ β_i * z_i(t) * sd_y[c], z_i = (x_i(t) - mean_x_i[c]) / sd_x_i[c] — the banked within-city standardized form, applied to inputs at T only
model_forms.direction_score: hit iff sign(pred - mean_y[c]) == sign(actual(t+k) - mean_y[c])
model_forms.magnitude_score: Spearman rho(pred, actual) within-city-demeaned (primary, mirrors the pooling convention) + raw; MAE and RMSE in rate-points

THE VERDICT (the machine's first out-of-sample validation): the prediction machine HOLDS at t+1 — every banked model beats the t0-carryforward persistence benchmark on direction AND magnitude (FE-3_arc 0.938 dir/0.959 rho/1.85 MAE vs persistence 0.531 rho/5.24 MAE; FE-6 0.806/0.76/4.14; FE-2 0.737/0.557/6.27; FE-3 t0 0.6/0.826/3.94)

THE DECAY LAW OUT-OF-SAMPLE: accuracy+fit DECAY with lag distance on every model — FE-6 rho 0.76 (t+1) -> 0.582 (t+2) -> 0.204 (t+3) -> 0.229 (t+4) -> 0.227 (t+5); dir 0.806 -> 0.538 -> 0.286 -> 0.188; persistence decays the same way (0.531 -> 0.264 -> 0.083) — the models sit ABOVE the persistence line at t+1/t+2, and fall toward persistence-level noise by t+3+

THE t+2 DEEPENING vs THE OUT-OF-SAMPLE READ: in-sample the banked B-lane arcs 'deepen with lag'; OUT-OF-SAMPLE under the FIXED betas the fit DECAYS not deepens — rho(t+2) < rho(t+1) on ALL FOUR models (the t2_deepening_out_of_sample block). This is fit-decay, NOT a direction flip: the predicted-vs-actual sign agreement thins with distance

THE FOUNDER-LITERAL (T=1990 -> 1991/1992): NYC care lane HITS both years (care +11.7%/+15.1% reads murder-down; actual murders 2245->2154->1995 down); the unemployment lane MISSES both years (unemp 5.9->9.5 reads murder-up while murders fall) — out-of-sample divergence between the two lanes in the Grogger-clause direction (care/wage margins > the unemployment margin)

THE 1980s-DECADE BLOCK: NYC care-lane t+1 direction 5 hits/7 years (0.71) through the crack surge; Boston 1980->1983 care-lane MISS (n=1 thin); the pre-2020 era carries the honest class-mismatch: the banked FE frames live in the 2014-2025 window — the 1980s test is count-space + literal, labeled as such
